name: Enfield House of Pizza
tagline: Family-run pizza place in Enfield, NH since 1987, with a different deal every day of the week.
seo_title: Enfield House of Pizza (EHOP) | Pizza, Grinders & Daily Deals in Enfield, NH
seo_desc: Enfield House of Pizza has served the Upper Valley since 1987. Pizza, calzones, grinders, burgers, wings and a different deal every day, Tuesday through Sunday. 554 US Route 4, Enfield NH. Call 603-632-5800.

feature.name: The Thanksgiving Pie
feature.desc: All the flavors of Thanksgiving dinner on one pizza: our homemade crust with a turkey gravy base, loaded with turkey, mashed potatoes and stuffing, topped with melted cheese and finished with a sweet cranberry drizzle.

party.desc: Kids pizza parties at Enfield House of Pizza are a build-your-own-pizza event. No room rental fee, just $10.00 per child. Drinks not included.

story.t: Alex Korakas opens Enfield House of Pizza. Lori Bliss Hill becomes his first employee while still a student at Mascoma Valley Regional High School.
Lori becomes sole owner. Alex passes on his long-held secret family recipes from Greece for the special pizza dough and sauce, still made today.
Lori buys property half a mile east of the original shop. The new Enfield House of Pizza opens July 4, 2001.

A community place: Mascoma High Project Graduation, Enfield Library Summer Reading, the Enfield Family Fair, David’s House Annual Auction, Toys for Tots and town celebrations. Lifetime members of the Royals Athletic Boosters. #fuelyourcommunity
